GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down Two Wide trailing just under a length, Drifted Back to 2 Lengths Two Wide turning, Lost Ground in Straight # no real excuses
Jumped Ok Went Forward Took sit Run Of Race 3rd Inside 2 Lengths Hard Ridden Turning for home clear run home Kept Trying but had its chance (b/ag t/t/1st) was # no match at all
Slow Out 0.4 Lengths Ridden Along recovering Through the pack Settled Down 3 Lengths off the lead 3 Wide (700m), spent turn, Under Whip no run on # tardy/wide/tired
Jumped ok Wide out pushed on 4 deep to second 1-2 Lengths (800m), got over Outside Leader Soon After , Straightened Up 3 Wide & looked spent, faded # wide/worked early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide until the 600m. Laid out rounding the home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped well landing in front soon headed settled down third 4 Lengths off Clear leader who ran them along (800m), coming wider Ridden Along approaching Turn , Straightened Up all out 3-4 Lengths off still, battled away Without threat # sound/stuck to task
Jumped okay & Settled Down 2 Lengths on fence, held together much same to turn then kept battling and Held Ground in straight. (Tongue Control Bit OFF FIRST TIME) # battled on ok

Jumped okay & Went Forward to 0.75 Lengths Lead on fence, Held Together in front & led by a long head turning, hung out badly and ran off track rounding turn, recovered and Made Ground to the line. [Stewards: Hung out from 1100m and carried another runner off the track passing 600m and around the turn. Trial required. Post-race vet exam revealed lacerations in its mouth.] # hung out badly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Commenced to hang out from passing the 1100m before carrying another runner off track passing the 600m and around the home turn. Official trial to Stewards satisfaction before racing again. A post-race vet exam revealed lacerations in mouth.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok 3 Wide of 3 let stride Settled Down 1 Lengths Clear race run to suit , Hard Ridden Turning for home found 1 1/2 Lengths , lay out by 200 then Couldn'T Go On - # had its chance
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported mount laid out throughout.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Turned its head as start was effected, slow out 1 length and Settled Down 3 Lengths 3 Wide , worked up to 2-3 Wide joint Lead at 800m, trailed Two Wide by 0.75 Lengths turning, Lost Ground but kept trying in straight. [Stewards: Inclined to lay out obliging its rider to stop and correct it several times in straight.] # battled on fairly
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Turned its head as the start was effected and slow to begin. Raced wide for the majority. Inclined to lay out obliging rider to stop and correct mount on several occasions in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay, no early pace & Settled Down behind the leading quartet, trailed 2.5 Lengths Two Wide turning, improved into a pocket rounding turn, shouldered clear at the 100m but failed to really make up any ground to the line. [Stewards: Jockey reported it was inclined to hang out at various stages and proved difficult to ride out to the finish. Post-race vet exam revealed no apparent abnormalities.] # Had some excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on multiple occasions shortly after the start. Rdr reported gelding was inclined to hang out at various stages and proved difficult to ride out to the finish. A post race vet exam revealed no abs. Warning for its racing manners.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bad fall this race no vision available # vision unavailable
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Fell near 150m. A post-race vet exam revealed soreness to the ribcage and lower abdomen. Vet cert required prior to racing again.
